g.text: Intervene at stalls: a confirmed controller improvement on three levels
900 completed episodes; new confirmation seeds, unchanged checkpoints, 50 simulations and no root noise. Error bars: Wilson 95%.
Dashed line: descriptive human first-life corpus rate (protocols differ). Stall trigger uses extra RAM x/player-state input.
On 1-1, gated sampling rescues 76/78 greedy timeouts but loses one greedy success. Evidence does not establish 86% > 83% or all-level benefit.
